about.title: About MangaTranslator
about.description: MangaTranslator is a work-in-progress manga page translator. Bring a supported image and your own AI provider API key to generate a translated page in your browser.
about.passionText: This project explores a clearer way to prepare manga pages for translation. The focus is a straightforward workflow that keeps the original page visible while readers choose a source and target language.
about.missionText: Our aim is to make manga translation tools easier to understand and use, while encouraging respect for the creators and rights holders behind the original work.
about.featuresText: Translate JPG, PNG, and WebP pages with Gemini, Grok, or OpenAI-compatible vision models, then preview and download the rendered result. Folder uploads, archive extraction, accounts, and saved translation history are not implemented.
about.visionText: Future work will focus on more reliable text detection, editable translations, improved lettering and background cleanup, archive support, and additional language options.

about.openSourceText: This repository is a frontend learning project. Translation requests go directly from the browser to the selected AI provider; there is no application server, account system, or persistent translation history. Check the repository's license before reusing the code.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.description: Answers about translation providers, supported images, privacy, and current limitations.

items.question: Which file types can I select?
items.answer: JPG, JPEG, PNG, and WebP images can be translated. ZIP and CBZ files can appear in the file chooser, but archive extraction is not implemented, so archives cannot be translated yet.

items.question: Does this build translate manga pages?
items.answer: Yes. Configure your own API key for Gemini, xAI Grok, or OpenAI in AI settings, then select image pages and start translation. AI results and rendered text placement can be inaccurate, so review each page.

items.question: Are my files uploaded to a server?
items.answer: When you start a translation, the image and prompt are sent directly from your browser to the AI provider you selected. This project does not include its own translation server. Review the provider's terms and privacy policy before use.

items.question: Are selected files or translations saved?
items.answer: Provider API keys and model choices are stored in your browser's local storage. Translation images and recent-translation entries are kept in page memory and are not persisted by this app. The selected interface language is also stored locally.

items.question: Can I translate into several languages at once?
items.answer: One target language can be selected per run. You can add multiple image pages, which are translated one after another.

items.question: Does the preview change my original image?
items.answer: The original file is not modified. The app creates a separate downloadable image, but its early renderer covers detected regions with a sampled color and may not preserve the artwork underneath.

items.question: Can I use these translations commercially?
items.answer: Copyright and other rights may apply to source material and generated output. Make sure you have permission for your intended use; this FAQ is not legal advice.

items.question: Do you support OCR for handwritten text?
items.answer: The selected AI vision model attempts to find and read text, but handwriting and difficult lettering may be missed or misread. Results need human review.

items.question: What languages can I translate from and to?
items.answer: Source choices are auto-detect, Japanese, English, and Korean. Target choices are English, Japanese, Spanish, and French. These are translation choices, separate from the language used for the interface.

items.question: Is there a batch processing limit?
items.answer: The app has no account tiers or page quotas. Provider rate limits, usage costs, and request limits still apply to your API account.

items.question: How do I report a translation error?
items.answer: There is no in-app feedback or support system connected in this build. Use a project contact channel only if the maintainers have published and verified one.

items.question: Is MangaTranslator open source?
items.answer: The interface does not establish a software license or verified community channel. Check the repository for its license and current maintainer-provided links before reusing the code.

faqs.ctaText: This prototype does not yet have an in-app support channel. Check for verified contact details from the project maintainers.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Your privacy is important to us. Read how we protect your data.

sections.title: 1. Introduction
content: MangaTranslator ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our service.

sections.title: 2. Information We Collect
content: Uploaded Files: When you upload manga images to be translated, we process them temporarily. These files are not stored permanently and are deleted within 24 hours of processing.
Usage Data: We collect anonymized usage statistics (pages translated, processing time) to improve our service. This data is never linked to your identity.
Device Information: We may collect information about your browser, device type, and IP address for security and analytics purposes.

sections.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
content: Process and translate uploaded manga images
Improve translation quality and AI accuracy
Monitor and debug service performance
Prevent fraud and enhance security
Send important service updates (if you opt-in)

sections.title: 4. Data Retention
content: Images and translation results are held in browser memory while the page is open; this app does not persist them.
Provider API keys and model choices are stored in browser local storage until cleared by the user.
The selected AI provider processes images and prompts sent for translation under its own data-retention policy.

sections.title: 5. No Tracking or Advertising
content: MangaTranslator does not use third-party tracking services, advertising networks, or analytics tools that profile your behavior. We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to any third parties.

sections.title: 6. Security
content: This project has no backend secret store. API keys are saved in browser local storage and included in requests from your browser to the selected provider. Use a trusted device and clear local storage to remove saved keys.

sections.title: 7. Your Rights
content: You have the right to request what data we have collected about you, request deletion of your data, opt-out of non-essential communications, and access and port your data.

sections.title: 8. Cookies
content: We use minimal cookies for session management and user preferences. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, though some features may not work optimally.

sections.title: 9. Third-Party Services
content: Translation requests are sent to the AI provider you select. This repository does not include an analytics or advertising integration, but a hosting provider may independently process website requests.

sections.title: 10. Children's Privacy
content: MangaTranslator is not intended for users under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we learn we have collected such information, we will promptly delete it.

sections.title: 11. Changes to This Policy
content: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Significant changes will be announced on our website or via email. Your continued use of MangaTranslator means you accept any changes.

sections.title: 12. Contact Us
content: If you have privacy concerns or requests: Email: privacy@mangatranslator.app, Discord: Join our community server, GitHub: Visit our repository for transparency.

privacy.lastUpdated: Last updated: June 2026. We take your privacy seriously and are committed to transparency.
